location_qualifier: Albert Canal front; the army headquarters place is not stated
current_activity: First Parachute Army (Student) is given the Albert Canal defence with FJ Divisions 3, 5, 6 and LXXXVIII Corps
notes: Event date: Schramm, OKW war diary (KTB 1944, western theater, p. 366), entry of 4 September: "neu eingeschobenen Fallsch.-AOK" ... "Student" ... "übertragen" (the OCR text reads "AOK 1" with a damaged digit); the same sentence gives it the Fallschirmjäger divisions 3, 5 and 6 and the LXXXVIII Corps. Event definition: the order of 4 September giving the army its mission and forces; the units named reach the canal later, so this is the assignment and not their arrival. Event support: the order is dated and quoted from the war diary; the army headquarters place is not given. Location: a representative point on the Albert Canal line between Antwerp and Maastricht with a precision of 50 km, because the source names the canal and no headquarters. Location approximate: the midpoint of Antwerp and Maastricht stands for the whole canal front. Location support fallback: fallback point only; the source gives no place for the army headquarters. Commander: Generaloberst Kurt Student.

current_activity: Student's First Parachute Army command post is at Vught, nine miles west of the drop zones
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 7 p. 139: Student "was at his desk in his command post in a cottage only nine miles west of one of the designated American drop zones" and his own account says "From my command post at Vught". Event definition: the command post seen at Vught on 17 September; Student's own account is quoted by CMH. Location: Vught, Noord-Brabant, with a precision of 3 km. Location support: Student's statement quoted in CMH names the place. Commander: Generaloberst Kurt Student.

location_qualifier: command post of 17 September; not documented for 23 September
current_activity: Model gives the First Parachute Army the II SS Panzer, II Parachute and LXXXVI Corps and Corps Feldt
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 8 p. 193: "Field Marshal Model on 23 September reorganized his command"; "Model assigned the First Parachute Army the following forces" ... "General Bittrich's II SS Panzer Corps" ... "General Meindl's II Parachute Corps" ... "General von Obstfelder's LXXXVI Corps, Corps Feldt". Event definition: the day of the order; forces west of the corridor boundary went to the Fifteenth Army on the same day. Event support: the order is dated by CMH, one source family. Location: the point is Vught, where CMH places the army command post on 17 September; no source read places it on 23 September, so the precision is 15 km. Location approximate: the command post may have moved; the point is a fallback. Location support fallback: fallback to the nearest dated command post (17 September). Commander: Generaloberst Kurt Student.
